The three NKE observations form a contiguous, dated sequence, each an unaudited consolidated statement of income with a matching income-statement review:

EPS falls $0.99 → $0.78 → $0.14 [REC-NKE-01-04, REC-NKE-02-02, REC-NKE-03-02]. Channel direction reverses: NIKE Direct -8% → -13% → -14%, while Wholesale flips from +5% to -3% to -9% [REC-NKE-01-04, REC-NKE-02-02, REC-NKE-03-02]. NIKE Brand Digital is the persistent drag (-10% → -21% → -26%), while NIKE-owned stores turn from -2% to +2% [REC-NKE-01-05, REC-NKE-02-03, REC-NKE-03-03]. Converse declines deepen (-18% → -17% → -26%) [REC-NKE-01-05, REC-NKE-02-03, REC-NKE-03-03].

**Accounting basis:** All three observations are reported (GAAP) unaudited consolidated income statements; currency-neutral figures are separately flagged as non-GAAP [REC-NKE-01-01, REC-NKE-02-01, REC-NKE-03-01]. No basis change is declared across the chain. Period labels are preserved as filed.

The early wholesale offset disappears; the later decline is broad-based, consistent with the stated margin driver "higher discounts and changes in channel mix" [REC-NKE-03-03].

Forward-looking optimism conflicts with realized downside.
- **Annual vs. quarterly:** FY24 full-year revenue essentially flat (+1% currency-neutral) [REC-NKE-01-04]; FY25 full-year revenue down 10% reported [REC-NKE-03-02]. Annual basis corroborates, not contradicts, the quarterly deterioration.
